description:
Platform-specific packages have accumulated in pyproject.toml core dependencies
that should be optional extras. This causes install bloat, dependency conflicts,
and cross-platform issues (e.g., PySpark requires Java).

Current core dependencies that should be optional:
- polars>=1.35.2 (DataFrame platform)
- datafusion>=50.1.0 (SQL/DataFrame platform)
- presto-python-client>=0.8.4 (SQL platform)
- clickhouse-driver>=0.2.9 (SQL platform)
- pyspark>=4.0.1 (DataFrame platform - requires Java!)
- dask[distributed]>=2024.8.0 (DataFrame platform)

Core dependencies should only include CLI essentials:
- click, rich (CLI framework)
- pyyaml (config parsing)
- packaging (version handling)
- jsonschema (validation)

DuckDB should remain as the default reference platform for ease of use.
